identity_policy.regression_case: Tianjin Medical University has same-title PCR procurement intents with 3000000 and 700000 CNY budgets but different official projId values; they must remain distinct.

source_topology.latency_policy: Only compare source publication latency when both source-native timestamps are MINUTE precision; otherwise LATENCY_UNKNOWN.

migration.policy: Medical product development continues here; Hermes keeps integration architecture only.

critical_rules: OFFICIAL_PUBLIC_FACT must never be model-generated.
Lifecycle type comes from official notice title, not project name.
Verified termination supersedes older verified tender only when chronology is source-evidenced.
Unverified newer events cannot override verified lifecycle state.
Month-only procurement intent dates must preserve month precision.
DAY-only publication dates must not be treated as true midnight timestamps.
Same-day conflicting lifecycle events with insufficient timestamp precision must be CONFLICTED instead of guessed into an order.
Exact project_number may link PRIMARY and mirror evidence to one canonical opportunity.
No-project-number records default to source-local identity; buyer/title similarity cannot auto-merge them.
Procurement-intent projId is exact native identity and same-title different projId records remain distinct.
Cross-stage candidates are review hints only and auto_merge_allowed must remain false.
Cross-stage chronology must compare timezone-aware instants, not raw ISO strings.
LLM may suggest cross-stage link candidates but may not perform canonical merge.
Every runtime source must explicitly declare provenance_role.
Attachment bytes must match snapshot SHA-256 before parsing.
Attachment declaration is not evidence that binary parsing succeeded.
PDF text/table blocks require page+bbox provenance before they can support evidence.
XLSX formula cached values are not deterministic facts in v0.1.
Award item facts require original official evidence section.
Customer profile missing conditions block high-confidence personalized recommendation.
Coverage remains PARTIAL while any required P0 source is only PARTIAL_IMPLEMENTATION.
